opis: Gdy cytujesz kogoś, jego słowa wpisują się w cudzysłowie w górnym paśmie kadru. Jak dymek — tylko elegancki.
najlepsze_do: Cytowanie klientów, ekspertów, własnych obserwacji, powiedzeń

przepis.opis_efektu: When the person begins quoting someone, a quote card appears in the top band of the frame (top 28–32% of height). Card: white rounded rectangle, soft shadow. Opening quotation mark in large elegant serif font (top-left corner, gray). Text types in word by word inside the quote marks — same rhythm as the speech, one word revealed every ~0.4 seconds. Below the quote text: a small attribution line appears after the last word — a tiny avatar circle and the person's name or role in small muted text. Card sits in the top band and never covers the face. Stays visible for the duration of the quote, then fades out over 300ms.
